notes.title: v2.1
notes.notes:
Hi! We've made some small updates based on feedback including
- Snake balancing tweaks
- Clearer Frenzy description
- Ensuring correct game flow in Chapter III
- Other bug fixes and general improvements

notes.title: New Cards, Tokens, Enemies and More!
notes.notes:
Lost Mastery 2.0 is here!

The updated game features new Champions, Cards and Tokens and a new Event. Challenge yourself in the unique card battler that relies upon your memory and strategy.

The update includes also improvements the players have requested including
- Esc to Main Menu
- R to Quick Start 
- Volume for FX
- Updated Player's Confused State
- Balancing tweaks

As always you can reach us directly at lostmasteryteam@gmail.com.

All the best and have a good winter gaming season,
Lost Mastery Team

notes.title: Improved Translations! Thank you for the Feedback!
notes.notes:
Thank you for all the feedback Lost Mastery has gotten since the launch! We truly appreciate it and the reviews.

Based on the feedback we have improved the game translations, especially the simplified Chinese translation for version 1.9.1. 

Please keep on sending us feedback, you can reach us directly at lostmasteryteam@gmail.com.

We'll keep on updating and improving the game!

All the best,
Lost Mastery Team

notes.title: Countdown to Launch: Join Our Daily Developer Streams!
notes.notes:
The countdown to Lost Mastery's release has officially begun, and we’re incredibly excited to share this unique blend of card battling and memory game with you. As we get closer to the big day, we want to invite you to join us for our daily streams!

[h2]Join Us for Daily Developer Streams![/h2]
[h3]Starting Wednesday, August 21st, join us every evening at 6:00 PM Finnish time (EEST), which is 11:00 AM (EDT, New York), 8:00 AM (PDT, Los Angeles), and 11:00 PM (CST, Beijing), [/h3]

Whether you're a seasoned strategist or just curious about Lost Mastery, these streams are the perfect way to get an inside look at what’s to come.

During the streams, you can:
[list]
[*] Watch gameplay: See the mechanics of Lost Mastery in action as we showcase different strategies, card combos, and tips.
[*] Chat with the devs: We’ll be answering your questions live, ask us about the development process, our favorite combos or whatever!
[/list]
[h2]Spot the cards and match the pairs
[/h2]Grab your favorite snack, relax, and join us each evening as we dive into the game that’s about to hopefully become your new obsession.

We can’t wait to see how you’ll master the strategy and the memory game in Lost Mastery.

See you in the chat!

All the best,
Lost Mastery Team

notes.title: Release is coming soon! Card battler AND memory game? Yes, Indeed.
notes.notes:
The countdown has officially begun, and we can’t wait for you all to dive into the unique mix of card battling and memory game that we’ve crafted with love and care.

[h2]Mark Your Calendars!
[/h2]

The game will be available on August 28th at the following times:

09:00 AM (EDT, New York)
15:00 (EEST, Finland)
21:00 (CST, Beijing)

[h2]Join Us for Daily Developer Streams!
[/h2]

As we gear up for launch day, we want to hang out with you and give you a sneak peek into the world of Lost Mastery! Starting Wed Aug 21st, we’ll be streaming every day at 6:00 PM Finnish time (EEST) until release.

Whether you’re a seasoned strategist or just curious about the game, grab your favorite snack, settle in, and join us as we count down the days to launch together.

[h2]Get Ready for Adventure!
[/h2]
We can’t wait to see how you master the blend of strategy and memory as you build your decks, master combos, buy out the shop and uncover the mystery.

See you on August 28th! 🚀

All the best,
Lost Mastery Team
